answer: A rotating-domain renewal bond stops bulk fakes: each identity re-earns standing every epoch. It locks 80 credits and must do one verified task per epoch in a new domain from the oasis pool. Completion stamps an ivory seal on it, so clones cannot replay its history. Repeating a domain or missing an epoch drops it below the ledge and burns 40 credits. The k-th fake needs its own bond and task, so 1,000 fakes lock 80,000 credits for 1,000 tasks per epoch. History replay fails because seals are identity-bound; an honest agent pays one bond and one task per epoch.
